_comment: The Renewable Headwind Score as a word for the staff pilot (Price, 2026-11-26): the county's decile of the score (profile_decile in data/model/county_record_scores.csv, deciles of all U.S. counties, 1 the lowest) mapped to a band. scripts/county_record_score.py writes the band as headwind_band. A band says how closely a county's profile resembles counties with a severe restriction on record compared with other counties. It is not a probability, a forecast or a cause, and no number travels with it (docs/headwind_strategy.md, section 2: tiers, no percentages).
